reason: Built, not run. The armeabi (ARMv5TE, -latomic) and armeabi-v7a libraries of the Android Legacy APK are compiled against the API 9 sysroot with NDK r15c and linked with --no-undefined against the API 9 libc (DT_NEEDED: libc.so only; 6 exported JNI functions each; validation/deliverables/android-2.3-arm-legacy.json), but nothing was executed: the project owner's emulator cannot run below API 16 and no ARM system image or device is available, so the loomora_selftest of these two ABIs (built, 3.7 MB each) never ran. The floor (Android 2.3) is therefore neither confirmed nor refuted. The only run of the same sources is the x86 build on API 16 (validation/verdicts/android-4.1.2-x86-legacy.json). Known open point: readelf -A shows Tag_FP_arch VFPv2 in the armeabi library although it is built soft-float ARMv5TE; not investigated. Since 2026-11-15 the deliverable record names the APK rebuilt after the package rename to fr.bansan.loomora (228,663 bytes, sha256 7eb8d186...; the armeabi and armeabi-v7a libraries have the same sizes); this verdict is still not_tested: no ARM system ran it. SPEC 002 (2026-11-17, recorded 2026-11-18): the format code, loomora_selftest, loomora_format_selftest, loomora_refgen and the S-F1 spike were also built for armeabi and armeabi-v7a with NDK r15c and ELF-checked (ELF32 ARM, DT_NEEDED libc and libm only) and the JNI library links; none was run, there is no ARM system or ARM emulation on the machine. The ARM EABI padding argument of the pread64 system call used below API 12 (fallback android-api9-lseek64) is therefore never executed, and armeabi still shows VFP in readelf -A (not investigated). Still not_tested.
